title: Text: DET Ron Colangelo ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Are you still writing your story?
Yeah
w/o "anonymous players"
No quotes
There is certainly information from anonymous teammates
Players will not be happy
I know
That's not my concern. I'm going to lose the clubhouse. I understand that.
Going to very uncomfortable for ██l
But in my opinion, I'm softening the blow
By taking the quotes out
I can't take the story out
Is there a way to b██ance it some?
I wrote about his past and how he has been considered a strong teammate. How Mr. I loved him. His stats.
Include that season has been a strain on everyone...
Ok
He would never admit if he was playing through an injury (if that is the case) but that may be a factor for his numbers and production being sub par compared to his other seasons with the Club.
He's considered "the biggest asshole I've come across in baseb██l"
You're good at your job, though
Think it through... is this something you have to write now? Five weeks to go in the season
Yes because it just became public with the █████████ incident
There is no more appropriate time
But that incident was a misunderstanding and those two guys are playing cards together like ██ways.
Was it a misunderstanding?
Neither has said such a thing
Or the manager
Yes. Neither wants to t██k about it.
Much different than saying it was a misunderstanding
You should ask Brad on the side about it. Misunderstanding.
Brad and I have t██ked about it.
I took the quotes out

Part of my job is to ██so look out for the media esp. the beat writers to get it right and establish an amicable and profession██ working environment. We encourage our players to t██k to the media esp the beat writers.
I understand that.
Funny, because your star player w██ked out of an interview when asked a follow up question about the incident
If you posted this season later in the season... there would be time before Spring Training to soften any animosity towards you for writing it
"You're lucky I'm t██king to you," he said. "You should stop."
I know what took place
T██k to Brad
I gave Brad an opportunity to t██k
Like I get what you're saying. It's your job. And I think you get this is mine
Off the record...
I do
Just think you should time it in your best interest
Are you planning to leave the beat?
It is timely now
Have you t██ked with ██?
I gave ██ a heads up this story was coming
Ok
I understand this
You going to Colorado?
A player texted me last night saying as much, that I'm going to lose the clubhouse
I know this. I ██so know my information is accurate and 90% of that clubhouse thinks the same thing
Yeah
It's just part of it. Not gonna be comfortable but it is what it is. There is a reason people in the clubhouse have been telling me these things
Do you characterized as "unsolicited" in the story?
Yes
Would still t██k with Brad...
How did pre-game go?
C██m before the storm
Players are not happy
Nope
They know
And does your editor know?
Yes
So Sipple will be covering the last five weeks?
I don't think that's an appropriate question to ask
I am trying to help you to do your job
Once you post the story, i can't help you if players decided to not t██k to you or the Free Press
I understand
